title: Lecture-style presentation in an industrial-ceiling room with digital clock and projection screen
objects_and_counts: Three people are standing at the front of the room and appear to be presenting; one of them (rightmost) is holding a wired handheld microphone.
At least twenty seated people are visible in the audience, arranged in rows facing the front; some seated people are partially obscured by others.
There is one wall-mounted digital clock showing the time '13:19' located above the projection area.
One large projected screen or projection area on the front wall displays the word 'Leadership'.
One freestanding whiteboard or marker board is visible to the right of the projection area.
Multiple white plastic chairs are visible; at least twenty of these chairs can be seen and many have small printed labels on their backs (labels are not fully legible in the image).

Exposed ceiling infrastructure is visible, including multiple rectangular metal air ducts and numerous suspended square or rectangular ceiling light fixtures; individual duct and light units are visible but not counted exactly.
A visible audio cable runs from the handheld microphone across the floor toward the front of the room.
spatial_relations: Three presenters stand centered in front of the projection area on the front wall; the speaker with the microphone is on the right of the three presenters (image-relative right).
The digital clock is mounted above the projection area, approximately centered horizontally over the projected text.
The whiteboard is positioned to the right of the projection area (image-relative right) and slightly set forward from the back wall.

Audience seating is arranged in multiple rows facing the front wall and projection area; the aisle(s) are between blocks of chairs and a microphone cable runs along the floor from front center toward the seating area.
Exposed HVAC ducts and suspended lights run along the ceiling above the entire visible room, oriented roughly parallel to the front wall.
colours_and_materials: Many chairs are white plastic with visible printed labels on their backs.
The floor appears to be unfinished or bare concrete, grey in colour.
Walls at the front are white or light-coloured to serve as a projection surface.
Ceiling ductwork is metallic (silver/grey) and the suspended lighting fixtures are white; some piping and conduit are painted red or green.
uncertainties: No room name or number is visible in the image; location cannot be determined from visible signage.
Exact counts of seated people and chairs are limited to visible items; additional people and chairs may be present outside the image frame.
Small printed text on the backs of several chairs and on name lanyards is not legible at this resolution and is therefore not transcribed.
The make, brand, or model numbers of the clock, projection equipment, microphone, lighting or HVAC components are not visible/readable and were not inferred.
Some presenters and audience members are partially obscured, so person counts are stated as minimum visible rather than a definitive total.
